content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real), Type.judge(@N, Nat)), Analysis.taylorPoly(F, x, N), Analysis.taylorPoly(F, x, N))
content.markdown: The polynomial of degree at most `N` whose derivatives at `x₀` up to order `N` agree with those of `F`, namely `Σ_{k=0}^{N} F⁽ᵏ⁾(x₀)/k! · (x − x₀)ᵏ`. It is the unique such polynomial, which is the cleanest characterisation and explains why the coefficients must be what they are.
